title: ALPR training records for SMPD personnel
summary:
Policy 463.4(d), Policy 463.9, SOP 205.3, and SOP 205.4 describe department-approved training before SMPD personnel operate ALPR equipment or access ALPR data, and identify three custodial locations for the resulting records: the Training Division, the POST Coordinator's METR records, and the ALPR Administrator.

This request asks for those training records covering 2019 through the present.

policy_promises.quote: The ALPR Administrator shall ensure that members receive department-approved training... The department POST Coordinator will maintain all training records in METR.
policy_promises.tests: What training records exist for SMPD personnel granted ALPR access?

policy_promises.quote: Prior to the operation... any person operating a system shall complete Department approved training. Records of this training shall be maintained by our Training Division.
policy_promises.tests: What training records does the Training Division hold across the period SMPD has been running ALPR cameras?

prior_pra_refs.note: W012174 covered training records for external-agency users. This request covers internal SMPD personnel training records.

filed_because: The policy and SOPs describe pre-access training and record-keeping for each member operating or accessing ALPR equipment. The request asks for those records.
notes:
Three custodial locations are named in policy: Training Division, POST Coordinator's METR records, and the ALPR Administrator.

Response received 2026-05-14 (Juliana Santiago, Management Analyst, SMPD). Closed same day.
